capabilities: Export the active note from the command palette or the file context menu
Recursively collect Markdown files reachable through wiki links and Markdown links
Include local attachments such as images, PDFs, and audio in the archive
Rewrite exported links to standard relative Markdown paths
Write a single zip archive to a chosen or configured directory
extras: Desktop-only plugin. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README includes a demo GIF placeholder that has not been filled in.
problem: Copying a single note out of a vault usually breaks wiki links, loses local attachments, and leaves relative paths that only work inside the original vault structure.
summary: Export plugin that bundles a note with recursively linked notes and local attachments into a zip archive with rewritten relative links.
